newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Seven die in hotel fire in south Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Seven die in hotel fire in south Philippines.

text.p: At least seven people died and more than 20 were injured in a fire early on Saturday that razed the upper floors of a popular hotel in Cotabato city in the southern Philippines, police said.
Firemen said they were still searching the rooms of the six-storey Imperial Hotel and they feared the death toll might rise.
The fire broke out on the third floor of the hotel shortly after midnight on Friday and was placed under control about two and a half hours later.
"The number of casualties might increase because we are still searching the rooms," fire chief Israel Dilawangan told reporters.
The fire destroyed the third, fourth and fifth floors of the hotel located in the downtown area of the city of 185,000 people.
Firemen were investigating the cause of the blaze.
